technical.summary: Multiple intermediate bullish indicators (RSI-14, MACD, EMA-9/21) with price above key moving averages, but weak trend strength (ADX 16.18), stochastic divergence, and below-average volume limit conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: LUV shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk with 86 days to next report.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (18/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite weak congressional selling and absent news confirmation; broad market capitulation dominates signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (432.8), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent FOMC event create severely adverse macro conditions despite distant earnings.

debate.key_bull_argument: Multiple intermediate bullish technicals (RSI-14, MACD, EMA-9/21 bullish; price above SMA-200) combined with extreme fear sentiment (18/100) create a contrarian accumulation opportunity near support at 42.157.
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak trend strength (ADX 16.18), stochastic divergence, below-average volume (0.76 ratio), zero fundamental conviction, VIX crisis (432.8), and unfavorable macro environment (FOMC event, rising dollar, flat yield curve) make this a high-risk entry with poor risk/reward in a capitulation market.

decision.entry_rationale: While price sits at support with intermediate bullish technicals (RSI-14, MACD, EMA-9/21) and extreme fear sentiment presents contrarian opportunity, weak trend strength (ADX 16.18), stochastic divergence, and below-average volume undermine conviction. VIX crisis (432.8) and unfavorable macro (FOMC event, rising dollar, flat yield curve) create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs the technical setup.
decision.primary_risk: Macro capitulation environment with VIX crisis and imminent FOMC event could trigger further downside despite technical support; stochastic divergence signals momentum exhaustion despite RSI bullish reading.
